facts.fact: The 2026/27 (EFY 2019) federal budget proclamation workbook appropriates ETB 6,293,131,040 to the Artificial Intelligence Institution (recurrent 693,131,040, capital 5,600,000,000), all from the treasury.
The same workbook appropriates ETB 5,000,000,000 to the project Artificial Intelligence University Construction, entirely from treasury with no loan or assistance.

note: Document also gives EFY 2017 capital (ETB 400m) but not for consecutive years, so no rose/fell fact.
